description: Datadog app for Slack: multi-alert metric monitor triggered for one group, priority P2, with message, snapshot, related tags and recipient handle.

Title '[Triggered on {group}] [Pn] <name>' and the monitor status link /monitors/<id>?group=..&from_ts=..&to_ts=..&event_id=.. (epoch ms, 15 min before to 5 min after the trigger) follow Datadog's notification conventions; the body lines are the monitor's own message template.
